taxi_day.basis: Full-day 'mixed points' (3-point Tiger Hill/Ghoom/Batasia sunrise + 7-point) is the Darjeeling full local day. darjeeling-tourism.com (Fare updated March 2022): 'Mixed Point tour (7 hours): Costs Rs. 3,500 in small taxi, Rs. 4,000 in larger taxi' through the Upper Clubside Vehicle Owners' Association, 'a small office run by the Taxi Association ... fixed rates' (the page also says the association chart 'can be completely misleading'; same page: 3-point 2,000, 5-point 1,800, 7-point 4 h 2,500 small taxi). touradviser.in ('Darjeeling Local Sightseeing Fare Chart (Updated 2026)', January 2026): 'Mixed Points (Full Day)' 4:00 AM-4:00 PM hatchback 3,500-4,000 (SUV 4,500-5,000, Innova 5,500-6,500). sdtravelsgroup.com (Unit 9, 3rd Floor, Home Square, NH10, Salugara, Siliguri; post dated 20 Apr 2026): 'A full-day sightseeing ... costs around Rs 2,500-3,500'. darjeelingtaxi.com (Rockwood, Chotta Kak Jhora, Darjeeling; undated, footer 2014; says rates are fixed by Government): 3-point sunrise + mix point 9:30 am-3:00 pm 3,000 for 4 pax car. The union-linked figure (3,500) is matched by the top of the 2026 operator ranges and sits at the upper end of the older ones; kept 3,500 because mid-Nov is high season.
taxi_day.notes: The union chart quoted by darjeeling-tourism.com is from March 2022 and is called 'indicative'. The GTA has a published fare chart that is 'not properly enforced' (same site). Local tours in Darjeeling may only be run by WB76 (Darjeeling-registered) taxis since 1 Apr 2018, so Sikkim cabs cannot do local sightseeing there. The mixed full-day tour starts with the 4 am Tiger Hill sunrise run. Zoo, ropeway, museum tickets extra. Peak season May-June and Oct-Dec; off-season up to 20% less (darjeelingtaxi.com).
